svg.text: character & bands come from the preset
place any slot on the surface.
pin = matrix_connect <source> <dest> <depth> · WHITE PIN depth + · GREEN PIN depth −
16 × 22 panel subset — full 44 sources × 26 destinations (incl. modout 1-4) reachable by message
sources: LFO ×4 · perlin ×4 · lorenz ×4 · nbody ×4 · sphere ×4 · rand ×4 · pattern 0-7 · input env follower · per-grain cols apply at trigger, never write the knobs
SOURCE SHAPE — MULTI-ENGINE EDIT (THE MATRIX ROWS)
A SIN/SAW/SQR: PHASE PERL: FREQ LRNZ: SIGMA NBDY: G SPHR: DAMP FOLW: RELEASE ms
B SAW: SKEW SQR: PULSE WIDTH LRNZ: RHO (chaos) NBDY: DAMP SPHR: ELAST
C LRNZ: BETA NBDY: EPSILON SPHR: SPIN D NBDY: PUMP amt (hold = interval) SPHR: KICK strength
RATE = IOT x scale (sources breathe with grain density; GLOBAL per instance) · KICK = sphere_kick impulse · RESET per family
all captured (v4) · FAMILY×INST feeds the SCOPE →
FOLW = the SOURCE SHAPE selection · GRAIN = constellation: X = splice pos, Y = env × amp
EDIT BUFFER — cold; ASSIGN is the only realtime touchpoint
edits are COLD — ASSIGN commits; AUDITION borrows the live voice and reverts exactly

Pd PROTOTYPE KEY: knob = [knb]/[hsl] → signal inlet · pin matrix = [tgl] grid → matrix_connect · joystick = [grid]/2×[hsl] → IN 23/24 · switch = [radio] · button = [bng] · splice display = [nbx]+[knb]+ENTER[bng] · reel = [openpanel]/[savepanel] → load/save
BADGES: IN n = signal inlet n (CV-drivable, headless 0/1 conventions apply) · MSG = message/preset-set (no dedicated inlet; automatable via the modulation matrix & param_range)
